grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is whole food or a plain tin, with no jars, stock pots or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: Hake fillets, aubergines, cherry tomatoes and tinned chickpeas are all everyday Tesco lines.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, a board and one large roasting tray, and the technique is simple roasting.

works.reason: Roasting the aubergine for about 40 minutes at 220°C softens it properly, the hake timing is right, and the quantities suit four.

honest_times.reason: Cubing two aubergines, wedging two onions and slicing garlic fits in 15 minutes, and 20+10+12 matches the 42 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon and basil, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Aubergine, cherry tomatoes and basil are at their peak in late August, and the aubergine is the bulk of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, chickpeas and plenty of vegetables make a filling, balanced family dinner.
